**What happened, and what you expected instead**

<!-- A clear description. If a build failed, paste the error. -->

**pebuild version**

<!-- Output of `pebuild version`. -->

**Windows source**

<!-- Edition, service pack, architecture, and language — e.g. "XP Pro SP3, 32-bit, English".
     `pebuild source probe <src>` prints how pebuild sees it. -->

**Manifest and command**

<!-- The `pebuild` command you ran, and the manifest (or the relevant part of it). -->

**Host**

<!-- OS and how you got pebuild (Linux is supported; macOS/Windows binaries are experimental).
     If it is a boot problem, how you booted it — e.g. QEMU line, or `pebuild run`. -->

**Anything else**

<!-- Does it reproduce with a minimal manifest? A screenshot, if it is a display problem. -->
